newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil down $2 but premiums little changed.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil down $2 but premiums little changed.

text.p: NWE gas oil dipped about $2 a tonne on Thursday morning despite little change on differentials paid for physical oil against the IPE.
April IPE was down $2.25 a tonne by lunchtime in thin volume but at $163.25 was still a couple of dollars above the contract low hit a month ago.
Dealers said the market was enjoying some support from Asia and saw a slightly firmer tone on EN590 or diesel cargoes which edged up to $10.50 a tonne above the IPE for April delivery.
Heating oil barges held at parity to the April IPE or around 50 cents under the front line strip.
Offers on Russian cargoes were unchnaged from Wednesday around April IPE +$2 cif against bids which were as low as April flat.
FOD was little discussed with the market reasonably balanced between tight supplies and limited demand.
